reuse_policy: Reuse existing evidence, UI and compatible calculation components. A rewrite requires a concrete unmet contract or defect; preserve original baselines and explain each change. No new product infrastructure is implied.

result_release_gates.interpretation: International research may inform Superjet products but must not block delivery of a valid original-case solution on its own accepted inputs.

scenario_axes.delivery_calendars: separate_by_type_and_variant; evaluate material joint branches, including one type delayed while another arrives; no assumed common dates or unsupported correlation

modelling_rules: Mandatory standalone CASE_SJ solution remains on Superjet project resource. Tu214 and mixed-fleet options are additional and separately labelled.
Common market and dated seat inventory across all programmes within the same scenario and fleet scope; one fare per journey.
KEEP uses the same future period and external conditions; project-specific competitor responses need an explicit baseline policy.
Compare entire affected business, own migration, donor and opportunity cost without duplicate deductions.
No radius, missing timetable record or presence of a competitor alone establishes economic rejection.
Net yield and demand respond jointly to price scenarios; fixed-pax arithmetic sensitivity is labelled as such.
Use calibrated behavioural or recapture parameters only when data supports estimation; otherwise scenario ranges and decision thresholds.
Unknown parameters are not zero; an unsupported interval remains unknown with exact field and impact.
Fixed programmes and reoptimised programmes are separate results; more available resource retains earlier feasible candidates.
Do not force profitable output, invented break-even date or invented delivery forecast.
Preserve author baselines and frozen results; candidate corrections and new evidence have separate lineage.

orchestration.slot_basis: existing_project_pool_default; changes are discussed, not treated as scope cap
orchestration.model_availability: verify via already-discovered orchestrator catalog and error rules at launch
orchestration.owner_boundaries: one task directory per worker, coordinator integrates pinned blobs
orchestration.early_handoff: versioned usable data tranches; dependencies do not wait for prose report

verification.completion: all_mandatory_requirements_have_deliverables_and_checks; unfinished is not rejection; conditional conclusions retain exact unknowns
verification.iteration_policy: fix_and_repeat_affected_mechanism; repeated failures trigger coordinator redesign, not blind full reruns
